description: [wallet-required, $0.08/call] AI-generated answer to a natural-language question, grounded in live web search results with source citations. Returns clean prose plus a structured citations array (URL, snippet, favicon) - backed by an independent search index, not the model's training data. Useful when an agent needs a synthesized answer plus the receipts to verify or follow up. Returns { query, answer, citations, citationCount }. This hosted connector holds no wallet: pay it here over MPP, or run npx agent402-mcp with a funded wallet (AGENT_KEY) or prepaid card credits (AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY), or any x402 client.

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on the generated answer length in tokens (default 1024, min 64, max 4096). Lower for TL;DR; higher for research questions.

name: web.answer
title: Web answer
